rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you for reaching out—I really appreciated meeting you at the meetup, and I'm glad to hear you'd like to help. The thing I most need right now is research on neglected areas. At the meetup I asked \"what's neglected?\" and got a lot of informal answers, but I haven't systematically mapped it. With your data analysis skills, here's a concrete project that would be genuinely useful: **Neglected areas survey** Could you help compile and categorize what people in AI safety circles identify as underworked? Sources might include: - Forum posts (LessWrong, Alignment Forum, EA Forum) where people explicitly flag things as neglected - Job postings or grant calls that go unfilled - Any surveys of the field (e.g., from 80,000 Hours or AI safety orgs) The output could be a simple spreadsheet: area, who flagged it, when, any links. Even a rough first pass would help me decide where Halcyon Threshold should focus. Does that sound like something you'd find interesting? Happy to jump on a call to discuss scope. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Email to Priya Raman — Accepted her offer of help and assigned her a concrete research project: surveying forums and literature to map what people in AI safety identify as neglected areas.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Weekly Halcyon Threshold Review" (0 9 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Set up weekly review schedule — Every Monday at 9am, I'll check in on progress, handle operational matters, and flag anything requiring your decision.
